Direct Python-backed R wrappers for upstream public functions

etpy_python_functions.Rd

Each wrapper forwards its arguments to the named public Python function through reticulate. These are not independent native R implementations.

Arguments

...

Positional and named arguments forwarded to Python as supplied. Consult the underlying Python API for signatures and required data.

.convert

Convert Python results to R if TRUE; by default Python proxies are retained for use in subsequent Python-backed calls.

Details

The upstream GitHub main API snapshot from 2026-10-25 contained 362 root and 18 workflow public functions. Root wrapper names begin with etpy_ and workflow wrapper names begin with etpy_workflow_.

Loading eyetrajectories does not initialize Python; using a wrapper does. An installed PyPI distribution may differ from this source snapshot. Run etpy_verify_api(strict = TRUE) to detect differences in public function availability. Optional Python dependencies and all scientific limitations remain inherited from the Python backend. R parity of names does not qualify any estimator's uncertainty coverage or validity.

Value

A Python proxy (default) or a converted R object.
